methodology.description: تم استخراج أسئلة الإجابة الحرة من مصادر الدرس (النص، التمارين، المحادثة) بناءً على الجمل العامة والمعلوماتية.
selection_criteria: السؤال عام ولا يحتاج إلى قراءة النص للإجابة عليه
الجواب واضح ومحدد وقصير (كلمة أو بضع كلمات)
methodology.verification_method: البحث عن الكلمات المفتاحية في إجابة الطالب (case-insensitive)
methodology.important_note: ⚠️ الأسئلة عامة ولا تعتمد على معرفة النص، ويمكن للطالب الإجابة من خبرته الشخصية.

questions.question: Which kind of food do you think is important for your health?
questions.translation: أي نوع من الطعام تعتقد أنه مهم لصحتك؟
suggested_answers: I think fruits and vegetables are important for health.

questions.question: What should you do to keep healthy?
questions.translation: ماذا يجب أن تفعل لتحافظ على صحتك؟
suggested_answers: I should eat healthy food and exercise.
I should eat fruits and vegetables.
I should sleep early and drink water.

questions.question: How often do you eat at restaurants?
suggested_answers: I eat at restaurants once a week.

questions.question: What is chicken like?
suggested_answers: It is tasty and good for health.
Chicken is white meat and delicious.

questions.question: Where do you prefer eating? Why?
suggested_answers: I prefer eating at home because it is healthy.
I prefer eating at restaurants because the food is delicious.
I prefer eating at home because it is clean.
